versions.changelog: Add explicit x402 curl examples for all 4 services
Add Brand Mascot service - 6-pose expression sheet
Add On-Brand GFX service ($2/graphic) for marketing communications. Supports any aspect ratio (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, etc.), both from brand-system.json and BYOL modes.
Add x402 direct API integration alongside ACP. Support Base USDC and Solana SOL payments via gateway.opengfx.app.
Added frontmatter metadata (homepage, source, author), clarified requirements - this is documentation-only, no binaries installed
Updated docs: AI brand naming (name optional), BYOL mode for socials, full input/output specs
Social service now supports BYOL (Bring Your Own Logo) — provide your existing logo URL and brand name, AI generates social assets
Brand name now OPTIONAL — AI generates the perfect name from your concept if not provided
Mirrored OpenVid structure, 30-day data retention, fixed support email
Added metadata (requires acp CLI), privacy policy clarifications, deletion contact
Added OG card (1200x628) + community banner (1200x480) to social package, added README
Fix ACP instructions - direct wallet address, removed browse step
Initial release - ACP integration for brand design
